lesson.name: Learn The Caro-Kann Defense
lesson.description: Learn the main lines and key ideas for both sides in the Caro-Kann Defense.

{Black has just blundered and White can already win the game. How should you
do it?} 6. Nd6# {[%wrong There's a checkmate, but that's not it. Look at your
checks and try again.] [%hint Look at your checks. Which one is mate?] Nice
move! This is an important trap for Caro-Kann players to avoid with the black
pieces.} *

{What clever sacrifice did a young Magnus Carlsen play to start a dangerous
attack?} 18. Ng6 {[%wrong There's a stronger attacking move. Try to find it
and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Sacrifice your knight so that if
Black captures it, you will win the e6-pawn and have a chance to open the
h-file toward Black's king.]} (18. Nxf7 $2 Rxf7 {White can capture on e6, but
won't have any threat or enough compensation for the lost piece. Try again.}) (
18. Bxh6 $2 gxh6 {Black is winning. Try again.}) (18. Bd2 $2 Qc7 {Black has a
safe position. Try again.}) (18. Nc4 $2 Qb4 {Black is doing well. Try again.})
18... fxg6 {Great move! GM Ernst would have been better off declining the
sacrifice, with a small disadvantage. Now Magnus has an unstoppable attack
against the black king. What did he play next?} 19. Qxe6+ {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Capture a pawn with check.]} (19. hxg6 $2
Qb6 {Black is winning. Try again.}) 19... Kh8 {Nice move! Now you can win your
piece back, but Magnus wants more!} 20. hxg6 {[%wrong Black is winning. Try
again.] [%hint Capture a pawn and start to clear the h-file for your rook.]
Well played! You can continue the attack in the next challenge.} (20. Qxe7 $2
Nd5 {Black is OK. Try to find a stronger capture.}) (20. Bxh6 $2 gxh5 {Good
idea, but sacrifices on h6 will work better without the h5-pawn blocking your
rook. How can you prepare to open the h-file?}) 1-0

{How did Magnus Carlsen continue his attack on the black king?} 21. Bxh6 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it. Check the hint if you're stuck.]
[%hint Sacrifice a piece (or two) to open the h-file.]} (21. Rxh6+ $5 {White
is better, but there's a stronger sacrifice. Try to find it.}) (21. Qe5 $2 Bd6
{White doesn't have enough compensation for the lost material. Try again and
look for a powerful sacrifice.}) 21... gxh6 {Great sacrifice! The h-file
towards Black's king is still only half-open. What can you do about it?} 22.
Rxh6+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it. Check the hint if you're
stuck.] [%hint If you can distract Black's g8-knight then you will be able to
capture the bishop on e7 with a powerful mate threat.]} (22. Qe5+ $2 Bf6 {
Black is winning. Try again and look for a stronger attacking idea.}) (22. g4
$2 Qb6 {Black is winning. Try again and look for a stronger attacking idea.})
22... Nxh6 {Great job! You're down a lot of material, but you can win some of
it back with a mate threat. How?} 23. Qxe7 {[%wrong Black is up too much
material. Try again and look for a precise capture.] [%hint Win material and
theaten mate on h7.]} (23. Rh1 $2 Bh4 {After Rxh4, Black will play Qd2 with a
winning position. Try again.}) 23... Nf7 {Good move! What's next?} 24. gxf7 {
[%wrong That lets Black off the hook. Try again and look for a strong capture.]
[%hint Capture the knight and keep attacking.] Well done! Black's king has no
defense and Carlsen soon won with a pretty checkmate.} (24. Rd3 $5 {White is
winning, but Magnus played a better move. Try to find a good capture.}) (24.
Qf6+ $5 {White is winning, but Magnus played a better move. Try to find a good
capture.}) (24. Rh1+ $5 {White is winning, but Magnus played a better move.
Try to find a good capture.}) 1-0

{Black's h6 advance was poorly timed. How should White start a strong attack?} 
6. Ne6 {[%wrong There's a better attacking move. Try again and look for the
perfect knight move.] [%hint Sacrifice a knight to decoy the black f7-pawn
away from defending the king.]} (6. Ne4 $2 Ngf6 {Black is doing well. Try
again and look for a stronger move with that knight.}) (6. Qh5 $2 g6 {Black
chases the queen with a good position. Try again and look for a strong knight
move.}) (6. N5f3 $2 Ngf6 {Black is doing well. Try again and look for a
stronger move with that knight.}) (6. N5h3 $2 Ngf6 {Black is doing well. Try
again and look for a stronger move with that knight.}) (6. Nxf7 $2 Kxf7 {
White doesn't have enough compensation for the lost knight. Try again and look
for a stronger knight sacrifice.}) 6... fxe6 {Black would be better off
leaving the dangerous knight on e6. How should White punish this mistake?} 7.
Qh5+ {[%wrong There's a move to checkmate soon, but that's not it. Look for a
good attacking move and try again.] [%hint Look for a check. Does it lead to
mate?]} g6 {Almost there. How should you end the game?} 8. Qxg6# {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try again and look for a way to end the game.] [%hint
Look for a check. Is it mate?] Well done! We will examine another version of
the trap in the next challenge.} *

{Black has blundered and White can win material. How should you do it?} 9. Qh5+
{[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a winning check.] 
[%hint Force the black king to d8 and control the fifth rank.]} (9. Bg6+ $2 Kd8
{White has only a small advantage. Try again and look for a stronger check.})
9... Kd8 {Great move! How should you win material?} 10. Ba5 {[%wrong Black is
doing well. Try again and look for a powerful pin.] [%hint Pin the black queen
to the king.] White wins the queen and should win the game. Well done!} *

{White's Qxb7 was premature. How should Black win material?} 9... Ndb4 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a strong threat.] [%hint
Protect your c6-knight and threaten a fork on c2.]} (9... Ncb4 $2 10. Bb5+ {
White checkmates in two more moves. Try again and look for a better knight
move.}) (9... Rb8 $2 10. Qxc6+ {White wins material. Try again and look for a
strong knight move.}) (9... Nxd4 $2 10. Bb5+ {White will soon win material.
Try again and look for a stronger knight move.}) 10. Bb5 {Good choice! How
should you take advantage of the poorly placed white queen?} Rb8 {[%wrong
There's a better option. Try again and look for a strong threat.] [%hint Use
your rook to nearly trap the white queen.]} (10... Bxg2 $5 {This is a good
move, but it's best to try to trap the white queen. How should you do it?}) (
10... Nc2+ $2 11. Kf1 {White is doing well. Try again and look for a strong
threat.}) 11. Qxa7 {Good idea! How should you win material?} Rxb5 {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try again and look for a strong capture.] [%hint
Capture the piece that pins your knight.]} (11... Nc2+ $5 {Black is doing well,
but there's a capture that's even stronger. Try to find it.}) (11... Bxg2 $5 {
Black is doing well, but there's another capture that's even stronger. Try to
find it.}) 12. Nxb5 {Well played! What's next?} Nxa7 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture the queen.] Great
work!} (12... Nc2+ $5 {This is a good move, but why not capture something?}) (
12... Nd3+ $5 {This is a good move, but why not capture something?}) *

{GM Fabiano Caruana has sacrificed two pawns for a strong attack. How did he
prove that it was worth it?} 24... Ng3+ {[%wrong There's a better attacking
move. Try to find it and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Sacrifice a
knight to get your queen to the g3-square.]} (24... Nxe1 $2 25. Rxe1 {White's
pawns offer decent compensation for the sacrificed exchange. Try again and
look for a better attacking move.}) (24... Nh4 $2 25. Qxe4 {Whtie has several
extra pawns. Try again and look for a stronger attacking move.}) (24... Qg3 $2
25. gxf3 {White is doing well. Try again and look for a stronger attacking
idea.}) 25. fxg3 {Great move! What's the idea?} Qxg3 {[%wrong There's a better
attacking move. Try again and look for a way to threaten mate.] [%hint
Threaten mate on h2.]} (25... Nxe1 $2 26. Rxe1 {White keeps a material
advantage. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 26. Qe5 {White
sacrificed to stop checkmate. How should you win material?} Nxe5 {[%wrong
White is winning. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture the
queen.] Great job! Black soon won in Aronian - Caruana, 2018.} *

{In the previous challenge White could have tried defending with gxf3. How
would Black force checkmate?} 26... Rg6 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try
again and look for a way to threaten mate.] [%hint Threaten mate with a
battery on the g-file.]} (26... Qxf3+ $2 27. Bg2 {White defends with a big
material advantage. Try again and look for a way to force checkmate.}) (26...
exf3 $2 27. Qe5 {White defends with a big material advantage. Try again and
look for a way to force checkmate.}) 27. Bg2 {White is helpless! What's next?}
Qxg2# {[%wrong There's a checkmate, but that's not it. Look for one and try
again.] [%hint Look at your checks. Which one is mate?] Well played!} *

{What clever move should White play to disrupt Black's development before
winning back Black's extra knight?} 12. Qc6+ {[%wrong There's a better option.
Try again and look for good check.] [%hint Check and make sure that Black must
keep defending the rook on a8.] Good choice! Black must play the awkward Ke7.
White will soon win back the knight on b5 and maintain an initiative in the
endgame.} (12. Qxb5+ $5 {This is playable, but another check is stronger. Try
to find it.}) (12. Nxb5 $2 Bb4+ {Black has a powerful attack. Try again and
look for a strong check.}) (12. Nxd5 $2 Qxd5 {Black keeps an extra piece. Try
again and look for a good check.}) *

{Black has fallen for a well-known trap. How should White win material?} 5. g4
{[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a good threat.] 
[%hint Begin to trap the f5-bishop with your pawns.]} Be4 {The bishop can run,
but not for long. How can you keep up the pressure?} 6. f3 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try again and look for a good threat.] [%hint Attack the bishop
with another pawn.]} Bg6 {Almost there? How should you finish laying your trap?
} 7. h5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a way to win
the g6-bishop.] [%hint Attack the bishop with another pawn.] Great job! The
bishop has nowhere to go and White wins a piece.} *
